stages.headline: If two angles of one triangle equal two angles of another, the triangles are similar.
stages.headlineEnglish: If two angles of one triangle equal two angles of another, the triangles are similar.

stages.headline: Key consequence: a line parallel to a side cuts off a triangle similar to the given one: DE ∥ AC ⇒ △DBE ~ △ABC.
stages.headlineEnglish: Key consequence: a line parallel to a side cuts off a triangle similar to the given one: DE ∥ AC ⇒ △DBE ~ △ABC.

stages.headline: Example: BD = 4, BA = 10, DE = 6 give k = 10 : 4 = 2.5, so AC = 6 · 2.5 = 15.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: BD = 4, BA = 10, DE = 6 give k = 10 : 4 = 2.5, so AC = 6 · 2.5 = 15.
